text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after the Selection Race, as I was heading home from work—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!!
You're the Trainer who was at the Selection Race yesterday, right?!
choice_data_list: I am, but is something the matter?
I am, but is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, ever since classes ended,
I haven't been able to find Ryan-chan anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan trains a ton every single day, so usually
she's guaranteed to be on the track or in the gym, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I checked both places today and couldn't find her at all.
She seemed a little off during yesterday's race, too, so I'm worried...
choice_data_list: I'll go look for her too.
I'll go look for her too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Really?!
Thank you, Trainer!! That's a huge help...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin and I split up
and searched everywhere for Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just on campus, but along the nearby riverbank, the park,
the shopping district, and around the station. After searching all over, finally—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait... Trainer.
What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that Ines Fujin had been worried about her,
and that I came looking for her out of concern as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... I'm really sorry for causing you trouble.
I'll make sure to apologize to Ines later, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was just in the mood to go for an outdoor run today.
I meant to head back before anyone got worried, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break here and looking at the view...
kind of brought back a lot of memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...There was a hilltop like this near the Mejiro estate, too.
If you climbed all the way up that long, steep hill, there was a beautiful view.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So back in the day, we used to race each other up there all the time.
To see who could reach that view first... all of us Mejiro kids.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Of course, that included McQueen, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Man, she was fast even back then...
choice_data_list: Have you known McQueen for a long time?
Have you known McQueen for a long time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Even among the Mejiro family, she and I were especially
close. We were childhood friends... or more like sisters, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Though, since I've always been like this and McQueen was always so put-together,
I never really acted like much of an older sister to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen... she's truly been an amazing girl for as long as I can remember.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She always thinks about how a horsegirl carrying the Mejiro name ought to act
and what kind of results she needs to deliver, and pours in the work for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She carries herself with grace, always keeps her appearance immaculate,
and lives up to the expectations of everyone who supports the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I... really respect McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —She's just so completely different from someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... 
You're very kind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I know the truth.
I can't do things the way McQueen does.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't run bearing the weight of our family name, nor do I have that kind of resolve.
No, even if I did... I'd never reach the heights of her noble spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just happen to like moving my body.
Really... that's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Besides, I'm not remotely close to looking like
a 'highborn noble lady'! Ahahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she put on a bright smile and laughed,
the issue she harbored seemed to run remarkably deep...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having honed her physique through relentless day-and-night training,
Mejiro Ryan undeniably possessed immense underlying ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet the self-doubt surrounding her 'reason to run,' which had built up
since childhood, seemed to be holding back her true performance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was there anything I could do for her?
Pondering this, I returned to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so McQueen's entering the 3200m turf event.
What should I do? Maybe go with the 5000m freestyle after all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There is no such event in the tournament!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the 'Category Tournament'—where every horsegirl at
Tracel Academy competes in their chosen events—was scheduled to begin soon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, Mac-chan, you're going for long distance again?
Wouldn't it be cool if you showed off a 1200m blitz for once?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My sights are firmly set on the Tenno Sho, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Many spectators will be attending the tournament,
so I must present a performance worthy of the Mejiro name!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the tournament, it seemed Mejiro McQueen intended
to aim for victory in her specialty, the 3200m turf race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The root of the issue Mejiro Ryan is struggling with
is undoubtedly Mejiro McQueen. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Me, enter the same race as McQueen?
choice_data_list: I won't force you, but I'd like you to consider it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's... well, it's not that I don't want to, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... when was the last time
I had a proper race with McQueen...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But why are you bringing this up to me now...?
choice_data_list: Because there might be something you can realize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Something I can... realize...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...All right. I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, when I went to check on Mejiro Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... that's a wrap, then.
...Mmh, no, just one more set—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Good work. You're really giving it your all.
Good work. You're really giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... well, I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... I submitted my entry yesterday.
I'm entering the 3200m turf event in the tournament, just like McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly... I don't even really know
why I ended up deciding to do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to train even harder than usual might just be
because I can't sit still, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Either way... I'm running.
Please come watch if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Ryan threw herself into
even more intense training than ever before...
